channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Manufacture Alabama announces House of Representatives endorsements for 2026 campaign cycle
item.description: Manufacture Alabama announced endorsements for incumbents identified as strong advocates for the state's industrial sector ahead of the 2026 election cycle.

item.title: Rep. Sewell releases statement urging Republicans to restore ACA tax credits
item.description: New Democrat Coalition leaders urged House Republicans to support a clean extension of Affordable Care Act tax credits amid the ongoing healthcare crisis.

item.title: Senate poised to revisit stablecoin rules as GOP, banks clash over crypto rewards
item.description: Conservative activist says Democrats and major banks are undermining Trump’s crypto agenda.

item.title: Birmingham City Council approves legislative priorities for 2026 session
item.description: Birmingham is asking lawmakers for expanded authority to combat blight, penalize neglectful property owners and support community development.

item.title: Alabama Democratic candidates urge unity, reform at election filing event
item.description: Congressional hopefuls gathered Wednesday, filing paperwork and uniting to present voters with feasible alternatives to longtime incumbent congressmen.

item.title: Montgomery commissioner says threats followed Jackson Hospital bailout vote
item.description: Dan Harris says critics threatened his family after Jackson Hospital vote as county weighs hospital bailouts, school tax, and fiscal stability.

item.title: Alabama Supreme Court weighs whether cops can demand ID
item.description: Attorneys argued Wednesday whether demanding identification from a non-suspect extends too much power to law enforcement, citing a pastor's 2023 arrest.

item.title: New bill would allow Alabamians to purchase digital driver’s licenses, nondriver IDs
item.description: The measure mandated that the state's law enforcement agency apply reasonable standards of security to protect user privacy and card integrity.

item.title: Alabama’s unemployment rate drops to 2.7 percent in November
item.description: The decreased rate followed new record highs for both the number of people employed and the overall civilian labor force, officials announced.

item.title: Will Boyd condemns Tuberville’s “shoot back” remark after Minneapolis ICE killing
item.description: Democratic candidate Will Boyd called Senator Tommy Tuberville’s suggestion that ICE agents “shoot back” after the recent Minneapolis killing “extremely concerning."
